contracts.declared_mechanism: MigrationStore._prepare reserved-key collision check: for every PutOp with a non-None value, if REVISION_METADATA_KEY ('langmigrate_rev') is present in the copied value dict, apply the on_reserved_key_collision policy set at construction — 'error' raises ReservedKeyCollisionError, 'warn' logs via logger.warning and proceeds with the overwrite. The guard is registered by wiring the wrapper via setup_langmigrate_store, which forwards the policy (default 'warn') into MigrationStore.

contracts.protected_operation: Store item writes routed through MigrationStore.batch/abatch (all BaseStore convenience methods, including put/aput, route through these two methods per the module docstring), specifically the stamping of outgoing PutOp values with the resolved target revision in MigrationStore._prepare ahead of persistence.
contracts.protected_resource: Persisted store item values held in the wrapped BaseStore — the application payload dicts and, within them, any application data keyed under 'langmigrate_rev'.
contracts.protection_obligation: Application data stored under the reserved key 'langmigrate_rev' inside store item values must never be silently overwritten when MigrationStore stamps outgoing PutOp values with the schema revision tag: MigrationStore._prepare inspects every PutOp before the wrapped store's write commits and, on collision, must surface it per the configured on_reserved_key_collision policy — raising ReservedKeyCollisionError under the 'error' policy (blocking the write) or logging a warning under the 'warn' policy (the default) before proceeding — protecting persisted store-item integrity.
scope_limits: The guard is inert when the migration registry is empty: _prepare returns the ops unchanged and neither stamping nor collision detection occurs (src/langmigrate/runtime/store.py:110-112).
Only PutOps with a non-None value are inspected; PutOp(value=None) (delete) passes through unchecked (src/langmigrate/runtime/store.py:115, 132-133).
Under the default 'warn' policy the write still proceeds after the warning — the overwrite is surfaced, not blocked; only the 'error' policy blocks the commit.

Collision detection applies only to store item values; the checkpoint-metadata stamping path (stamp_metadata / MigrationInterceptor) deliberately has no collision policy (src/langmigrate/core/version.py:29-33).
Detection is exact top-level key equality with 'langmigrate_rev' in the item value dict; nested occurrences or differently named keys are not covered.
